title: Provisions of law may not be waived by agreement.
bodyText: No provision of this chapter may in any way be contravened or set aside by private agreement.
bodyHtml: [§387-4.5]  Provisions of law may not be waived by agreement.  No provision of this chapter may in any way be contravened or set aside by private agreement. [L 1977, c 92, §1]
